title: Every panel section in a video document expands and collapses, and none shows that cannot
goal: User 2026-10-02: 'in video, I see collapsed panels that can't be expanded. Never show panels that aren't enabled in a mode. Or, fix the bug to ensure they can be expanded if that's the case... I think it might actually be a bug that I can't collapse/expand these.' Reproduce with a real pointer click on each section header's chevron and title in a video document (View and Edit, with nothing, a clip, a title and a shape selected): which sections ignore the click, and why (header hit target covered, state not stored per section, section forced collapsed by video mode, the panel order logic TimePanelOrder overriding the user's choice).
acceptance: Reproduced first: a walk at Next defaults opens a recording in Edit, and for each section in the right panel clicks its header with the pointer (not an accessibility press) and records whether it opened and closed; the report names the cause
Every section shown can be expanded and collapsed by clicking its header (chevron or title), with the standard animation, and remembers its state per section
A section with nothing to show for the current selection or mode is not shown at all (no permanently collapsed or empty sections), per the IA rule that every area serves its purpose
Keyboard: the header is focusable and Space or Return toggles it
The same check passes in a picture document

log.note: Reproduced: with the user's own folded set (Time, Captions, Transitions, Effects, Text) written into the probe, a real click on a header in a recording with NOTHING picked (front, press step) saved the change (logged toggle + defaults write) but the header stayed shut. Cause: the dock's rows are built in closures capturing the panel, whose @AppStorage compares equal to itself, so a click that changed only a fold left SwiftUI sure the rows were unchanged and they were never rebuilt (body ran, ForEach content did not). With a clip picked the click also moved the dock height budget, which rebuilt the rows, so it worked there and in pictures. Not a hit-target, per-section storage, TimePanelOrder or video-mode problem.

Fix: InspectorPanel.body reads the folded set once (foldedSections) and hands rows a value, so a fold change rebuilds them. Header is now focusable for activation (Tab with keyboard navigation on), Space/Return toggles, button trait + expanded/collapsed value. A click does not take the keyboard (walk checks Space still plays). New walk every-section-header-opens-walk clicks every header shut and open: nothing picked, clip, title, shape, View (no panel), picture; it FAILS on the old build at the user's case. No empty or permanently shut section found: every section shown has content when open.

left rough: Space/Return on a focused header not walk-proven. Keyboard navigation is a system-wide setting, off on this Mac; setting it in the probe's own domain was not honoured, and I would not change the user's system setting. Listed in the audit's rough for the user to try. Did not earn a task.
